relationship_kinds.name: AWS_CanUpdateSelfPolicy
relationship_kinds.description: Principal can rewrite a permission container it is already subject to — its own user/role inline or attached policy, or a customer-managed policy attached to it (directly or via a group) — granting itself admin with no assume step. Targets the account; gated by the principal having no capping permissions boundary. The methods property records the usable self-modification techniques.

relationship_kinds.name: AWS_CanUpdateOtherPolicy
relationship_kinds.description: Principal can both control another principal (CanAssumeRole for a role; CanCreateAccessKey/CanCreateLoginProfile/CanUpdateLoginProfile for a user) and re-permission it (put/attach policy, or CreatePolicyVersion on a policy attached to it), letting it grant the dest admin and act as it. Targets the account; gated by the dest having no capping permissions boundary. The methods property records, per dest principal, the control and re-permission techniques.

relationship_kinds.name: AWS_CanUpdateAssumeRolePolicyAndAssume
relationship_kinds.description: Principal can modify a role's trust policy and has sts:AssumeRole, enabling them to rewrite the trust to include themselves and then assume the role

relationship_kinds.name: AWS_CanCreateAndAssumeAdminRole
relationship_kinds.description: Principal can create a new IAM role (iam:CreateRole), attach an admin policy to it (iam:AttachRolePolicy/PutRolePolicy on role/*), and assume it (sts:AssumeRole) — a self-trusting admin role they assume directly, gaining account admin

relationship_kinds.name: AWS_CanCreateAndPassAdminRole
relationship_kinds.description: Principal can create a new IAM role, attach an admin policy to it, and pass it to one or more AWS services (EC2/Lambda/CloudFormation/EKS) to execute as it — account takeover. The services/methods properties record which services are usable

relationship_kinds.name: AWS_CanCreateAndAccessAdminUser
relationship_kinds.description: Principal can create a new IAM user (iam:CreateUser), grant it admin (iam:AttachUserPolicy/PutUserPolicy on user/*), and mint usable credentials for it (iam:CreateAccessKey/CreateLoginProfile on user/*) — a fresh admin user it controls, gaining account admin. User-side mirror of AWS_CanCreateAndAssumeAdminRole; the methods property records the grant + credential techniques

relationship_kinds.name: AWS_CanDeleteRolePermissionsBoundary
relationship_kinds.description: Principal can call iam:DeleteRolePermissionsBoundary to remove a permissions boundary from a role, widening its effective permissions. Non-traversable: deleting a boundary does not by itself grant control of the role.
